IRON.headline: Disc Medicine to Host Corporate Webcast to Discuss Topline Results from the APOLLO Phase 3 Trial of Bitopertin in Erythropoietic Protoporphyria (EPP)
IRON.description: Disc Medicine announced it will host a webcast on October 19, 2026 to discuss topline results from the APOLLO Phase 3 trial of bitopertin in EPP. Bitopertin is an investigational oral GlyT1 inhibitor designed to modulate heme biosynthesis and has potential to be the first disease-modifying therapy for erythropoietic porphyrias.

CLF.headline: Why Cleveland-Cliffs Stock Popped Today
CLF.description: Cleveland-Cliffs stock surged over 16% after reporting adjusted earnings of $0.28 per share, beating estimates of $0.21. The company's adjusted EBITDA more than doubled to $612 million in Q3, with expectations to exceed $700 million in Q4. Strong steel prices and tariffs limiting imports are driving robust 2027 outlook with over $4 billion in projected adjusted EBITDA.

CLF.headline: Pre-Market Indexes Mixed
CLF.description: Pre-market futures show mixed signals with the Nasdaq up 376 points while the Dow is down 88 points. Fifth Third Bank reported mixed Q3 earnings with EPS beating expectations but revenues missing, while Cleveland-Cliffs surged 15% after beating both earnings and revenue estimates. Housing data this week is expected to remain weak, with the NAHB Housing Market Index projected to stay well below the 50 breakeven point.

CLF.headline: Pre-Markets Mixed Ahead of New Q3 Earnings, Housing Data
CLF.description: Pre-market futures showed mixed performance on October 19, 2026, with the Nasdaq up 376 points while the Dow fell 88 points. Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF) jumped 15% after beating earnings expectations on both revenue and earnings per share. Fifth Third Bank (FITB) reported mixed results with EPS beating consensus but revenues missing expectations. Housing data showed continued weakness with the NAHB Housing Market Index expected to decline further below the 50 breakeven point.

CLF.headline: Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
CLF.description: Cleveland-Cliffs reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.28 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.24 and showing significant improvement from a $0.45 loss a year ago. Revenue reached $5.61 billion, slightly exceeding expectations. However, the stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 20.6% year-to-date. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.
